name: SegmentedControl
description: Pill switcher on a transparent-black-04 wash; the active segment is a fully-rounded knockout-black pill inset 4px with a white label. Figma ships a fixed 3-up; code generalizes to any segment count.

props.name: segments
props.description: Segment labels (Figma Seg 1/2/3 text props, generalized)

props.name: selected
props.description: Index of the active segment (Figma Selected=1|2|3, 0-based here)

tokenBindings.padding-inline:cta: --s2a-spacing-20 (primitive — Figma uses raw 20px, no semantic rung exists at 20)
tokenBindings.font:label: --s2a-typography-*-label + --s2a-font-family-label

notes: Modeled as a tablist (content switcher: Individuals/Businesses/AI Pro switches displayed content) rather than a radiogroup — Figma has no form-input affordance and usage context is view switching. Swap to radiogroup semantics if used to capture a form value.
Active state is signaled by the pill shape + inversion, not color alone (1.4.1).
Roving tabindex: active segment tabbable, others -1; arrow-key navigation must be wired by the consumer (pure HTML/CSS package).
Figma defines no hover/focus/disabled variants; hover darkens inactive labels and focus uses the standard --s2a-color-focus-ring-default ring as sensible defaults.

knownGaps: Item inline padding is 20px in Figma with no bound token and no semantic rung at 20 — uses primitive --s2a-spacing-20 with a 20px fallback.
